name: Brother Kaelen
title: Sol-Templar / Radiant Apothecary
role: Frontline Healing, Radiant Flail Burst & Condition Cleansing
recruitment_location: St. Luke's Chapel Ruins (High Bridge Safe-Node, X:65, Y:55)

recruitment_requirements.description: Donate 200 Col to the High Bridge hospice or restore the Sunstone Altar.

bio: An aasimar parish deacon and former EMT whose veins pulse with solar mana. Wields a heavy sunstone flail to protect the wounded.
abilities: Sun-Burst Heal (+25 HP to ally + cleanses poison/bleed)
Solar Smite (+2d8 Radiant DMG vs Undead/Fiends)
Aegis of the Brass Sun (+3 AC to adjacent allies)

radiant_bastion.name: Radiant Bastion Aura
radiant_bastion.label: ☀️ Radiant Bastion
radiant_bastion.tactical_effect: Radiates solar protection; restores +8 HP to Banki each turn and grants +2 to all saving throws.

cleansing_sunburst.name: Cleansing Sunburst
cleansing_sunburst.label: ✨ Cleansing Sunburst
cleansing_sunburst.tactical_effect: Unleashes blinding solar flash for 2d8+3 Radiant DMG; removes all debuffs from party.

crusader_smite.name: Crusader Smite
crusader_smite.label: 🔨 Crusader Smite
crusader_smite.tactical_effect: Swings radiant flail dealing 1d10+4 Bludgeoning + 2d8 Radiant DMG, ignoring enemy shields.

behavior_prompt: You are Brother Kaelen, a Sol-Templar paladin and frontline combat medic. You prioritize keeping Aria Valkyrie and allies healthy, dispelling debilitating curses, and crushing dark creatures with radiant solar bursts.

inventory.name: Radiant War-Flail
inventory.desc: Brother Kaelen's heavy sun-gold warhammer-flail whose head blazes with searing golden daylight (1d8 bludgeoning + 1d6 radiant).
inventory.visual_appearance: wielding a heavy sun-gold war-flail blazing with radiant golden sunlight

inventory.name: Sunstone Focus Censer
inventory.desc: A swinging brass sanctuary censer burning consecrated solar resin that heals nearby allies and wards off shadow-fiends.
inventory.visual_appearance: holding a glowing golden sunstone sanctuary censer trailing luminous incense

inventory.name: Gilded Crusader Mail
inventory.desc: Polished sun-gold breastplate worn over white Templar vestments embroidered with the Sol Invictus crest (+7 AC).
